description: Eurelectric, the European electricity industry association, runs an online data platform covering the EU countries, Norway, the United Kingdom and Switzerland. The pages read on the day cover electricity generation by fuel and total generation; total CO2-equivalent emissions, emissions by fuel and emissions intensity, with comparisons to 1990 and 2030; electricity demand and load curves; day-ahead wholesale prices by bidding zone; retail electricity and gas prices for household and industrial consumption bands split into energy, network and tax components; installed capacity; net cross-border flows between countries and with the EU; and capture prices and rates. Users choose geography and period, from hourly to annual, and can export data or download charts for free from each chart; the export page states that bulk API access is available to premium users, academic users and European institutions on request by email. Coverage is Europe. No licence or source list was visible on the pages read. Caveats: the site is a JavaScript application, the upstream sources of each indicator were not stated in the text read, and flows and prices may repeat transmission operator and exchange data. Simulation uses are country-level generation mixes, demand, prices and net flows for European dispatch and adequacy models. Related records: data-entsoe-transparency-platform gives the underlying system data.
